entries.summary: Restore dirty corpse salvage and sparse thematic caches as independent CBM scavenging routes.
details: Scientists, technicians, military zombies, and bio-operators retain skill-scaled dissection salvage alongside Exodii zomborgs.
Hospitals, mines, science sites, Robofac, and selected secure locations again offer low-rate CBM discoveries.

entries.summary: Restore the Railgun and the Integrated Multitool's classic utility without removing later CBMs.
details: Railgun returns beside Throwing Assist and consumes 10 kJ only when enhancing a ferric throw.
Both Integrated Multitool forms again provide the classic hammering, sawing, wrenching, prying, and drilling qualities.
